title: Christmas at The Anchor, and how booking works
preheader: Six or more, your own table, and everyone picks their own courses. Here is how it works.

data.headline: Your own table, your own evening
data.body: We serve Christmas dinner from 10 November to 20 December. A village pub rather than a hotel function room, so your group gets its own table and never a shared sitting with strangers.

steps.title: Tell us your date and numbers
steps.body: Six guests or more. Over twenty becomes a private hire.

steps.title: Pay the deposit
steps.body: £10 per person, taken straight off your final bill.

steps.title: Send your pre-order
steps.body: Everyone's courses and dietaries, 7 days before your date.

rows.label: Sittings
rows.value: Tuesday to Saturday, plus Sunday 1pm to 6pm. No Mondays

rows.label: Group size
rows.value: 6 guests or more. Over 20 becomes private hire

rows.label: Deposit
rows.value: £10 per person, taken off your bill

data.label: Please note.
data.body: The kitchen is closed on Mondays, so there are no Monday sittings.

data.text: December Fridays and Saturdays go first.

items.question: Will we share a table with another group?
items.answer: No. Your group gets its own table and its own evening.

items.question: Does everyone have to order the same thing?
items.answer: No. Everyone picks their own courses, so nobody is tied to what the rest of the table is having.

items.question: What does the deposit cover?
items.answer: £10 per person, and it comes off your final bill rather than being an extra.

items.question: Is there parking?
items.answer: Around 20 free spaces on site, and we sit outside the ULEZ boundary.

data.body: We stood here long before Heathrow did, and we would rather host your evening than process it.

data.heading: Lunch is back from 1 September
body: From Tuesday 1 September we are serving from midday again, Tuesday to Friday, so a proper sit-down lunch is seven minutes from Terminal 5.
list_items: Lunch 12pm to 3pm, dinner 4pm to 9pm, Tuesday to Friday
The kitchen is closed on Mondays

data.ps_body: Pre-orders are due 7 days before your date, so the earlier it is locked in, the easier it is on everyone.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you enquired about a booking or an event with us, or because you may be close to us and we thought this information would be helpful to you.
